candidates.claim: Test a decode-sized MegaMoE workspace for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on the eight-B200 node, conditional on the deployed engine selecting FlashInfer CuTeDSL MegaMoE and supporting the required workspace API. PR #62073 describes a capacity of `max_num_seqs × (1 + num_speculative_tokens)` per sequence-parallel rank, selected only when every data-parallel rank fits because peer offsets depend on shared capacity. A smaller active workspace might reduce decode address or capacity overhead, but its extra allocation and warmup could take memory from KV cache and reduce useful concurrency. No controlled DeepSeek B200 decode performance measurement appears in the inspected sources; the PR throughput measurement concerns Beam prefill on GB300. Establish backend inclusion and the actual DSpark verification token bound first, then compare full serving behavior and correctness against a fixed-workspace control. The B200 decode bottleneck and effect size are unknown.

alternatives: The deployed backend already selects the smaller workspace.
MegaMoE workspace overhead is too small to affect serving, or extra allocation reduces KV capacity enough to offset it.
